## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

- [ ] I read the change notes in `docs/` and this doesn't bring back an idea that was rejected there (or I explain why).
- [ ] `./build.sh` finishes with no errors.
- [ ] I checked the change in the running app (and the panel snapshot, for UI changes).
- [ ] `README.md` (for users) and/or `TECHNICAL.md` (for details) are updated.
- [ ] I added a change note in `docs/changes/` and a line for it in `docs/README.md`.
- [ ] If this touches `Helper/` or anything that runs as root, I explained how input stays validated.
